description: Prints a day name from a menu number using a switch statement, which the subset does not support.
notes: Expected under plan 002: raw 8. SYN-UNSUPPORTED-FEATURE 6 (caused_by: none), SYN-UNSUPPORTED-FEATURE 7 (caused_by: R2), SYN-UNSUPPORTED-FEATURE 10 (caused_by: none), SYN-UNSUPPORTED-FEATURE 13 (caused_by: none), SYN-UNSUPPORTED-FEATURE 16 (caused_by: none), SEM-BREAK-OUTSIDE-LOOP 9 (caused_by: none), SEM-BREAK-OUTSIDE-LOOP 12 (caused_by: none), SEM-BREAK-OUTSIDE-LOOP 15 (caused_by: none). Panic after 'switch' stops before '{' (orphan block, kind switch). 'case 1' is reached while that region is open, so R2 links it; its panic consumes a ';', closing the region, so 'case 2', 'case 3' and 'default' are unlinked. The three 'break;' statements are in an orphan block whose ErrorStmt kind_hint is 'switch', so R7 does not apply and they are unlinked. Assumes case/default are UNSUPPORTED_KEYWORDs (language-spec section 1). gcc accepts the file, so gcc_rejects is false.
